critical.finding: The scorer checks a planned candidate digest but neither requires nor compares the digest, resolved path, or device/inode identity of the process that actually executed.
critical.acceptance: Require one canonical executed-process record per arm and bind its binary digest to the frozen campaign digest, with missing, wrong, duplicate, stale-path, and conflict mutations rejected.

high.finding: Extra malformed samples and an earlier failed SAFE_RUN terminal record are ignored when enough valid lines and one later success exist.
high.acceptance: Parse every safety line with an exact grammar and require exactly one containment record and exactly one successful terminal record.

high.finding: The campaign can declare only the normal path, zero fused coverage, and pass.
high.acceptance: Hard-code the complete normal-plus-fused path mix in the frozen scorer and reject deletion, reordering, duplication, or zero coverage.

medium.finding: Compiled tests do not compare complete ordinary and fused stores under selector states resolved from unset versus explicit zero.
medium.acceptance: Add one focused end-to-end unset-versus-zero equality test with zero applied-path counters.

critical.finding: The scorer accepts caller-authored embedded log strings and has no frozen runner or artifact-hash binding; its passing test constructs an entire fictitious campaign in memory.
critical.acceptance: Use a frozen runner that writes exclusive per-arm files and a hash manifest, and score those files only after verifying every digest. Post-execution mutation or replacement must reject.

high.finding: The record can remove fused from candidate_required_paths and pass with fused_rows zero.
high.acceptance: Remove caller control over required paths and hard-code both production paths in the scorer.

high.finding: The scorer accepts one normal and one fused row regardless of evaluated workload.
high.acceptance: Bind exact applied coverage to independently defined store opportunities and require equality for both paths.

root_reproduction.method: Mutate the existing passing unit campaign and invoke the frozen candidate-3 scorer without changing source.
root_reproduction.self_declared_subset: PASS after required paths became [normal] and both candidate fused counters became zero.
root_reproduction.partial_counts: PASS after both candidate path counters became one.
root_reproduction.wrong_executed_binary: PASS after every executed-process line carried a digest different from the frozen binary digest.
root_reproduction.ignored_contradictions: PASS after every arm gained a malformed nonzero-swap sample and a failed terminal record before the accepted success record.
root_reproduction.result: Both critical findings and all four high findings independently VERIFIED. No model run is authorized.

convergence.assessment: The engine-side blocker set closed, but the campaign-evidence authority class became concrete. This is the first non-shrinking candidate; the enumerated two-consecutive-candidate trigger has not fired. Candidate 4 is bounded to the round-312 findings.

decision: Candidate 3 is permanently rejected before any model run. Candidate 4 may change only file-backed artifact authority, executed-process binding, fail-closed safety parsing, fixed path coverage, applied-versus-opportunity counters, and the medium unset-versus-zero regression test.
